programs.title: Misfit Garage 3
programs.desc: Mechanics from the Fired Up workshop in Dallas, Texas, specialize in restoring old, classic cars and building unique hot rods to order.The team is celebrating its first year of operation.Thanks to the experience and prestige they have gained, the guys decide to take on truly ambitious projects.One of them is the restoration of a rare 1978 Chevrolet Blazer with two-wheel drive.Additionally, Thomas has the opportunity to purchase a highly sought-after 1963 Pontiac Grand Prix.

programs.title: Road absurdities 4
programs.desc:
In the next series, Kamil Jaśkowski and Krzysztof Ruszała continue their developing trips around Poland, during which they look for the causes of various absurd road solutions.Using a prototype siren with the mysterious symbol S201, they will go to places where officials lightly spent huge amounts of money on non-functional communication infrastructure facilities.A bicycle path with pedestrian crossings every few meters, a speed limit for only one lane, a "zebra" right behind the "parking" sign, poles at the entrances to the garage, a street lamp in the middle of the road - this is just the beginning of the list of topics that tireless hunters of road stupidity will face.
In Lublin, absurdity hunters will encounter a confusing no-entry sign and decorated barriers forcing alternating traffic on the bridge.They will also learn why there are double markings on the narrow entrance road in Puławy.In order to comply with the law, they will decorate the mermaid as a "vehicle serving church ceremonies on the sidewalk."In Kraśnik, Krzysiek and Kamil will find a roundabout in the shape of a sperm.In Świdnik, their attention will be attracted by granite blocks replacing horizontal stripes on the road.They will also explore the mystery of Poniatowa and the busiest roundabout in our country.In Józefów, they will look at a barrier on a short sidewalk, as well as an unusually large number of signs informing about parking possibilities.

programs.title: Megatransporty 2
programs.desc: The convoy with the first windmill is waiting in a parking lot near Hamburg for sets carrying the second windmill.Routine inspections take place at night.German police say there is no registration certificate.The team must also additionally secure the load supports.A team from Opole, transporting a hundred-ton baler from Świnoujście to Kashubia, has trouble passing through the gate.Further travel is made difficult by the nearly 6-meter-wide load and the damaged tarpaulin.Meanwhile, the team from Zabrze, transporting a large forklift, is getting ready to hit the road after an all-day stop.The team must cover another 620 kilometers in just two nights.

programs.title: Supertruckers 3
programs.desc: The camera will visit employees of the Kings Heavy Haulage transport company, which operates in Bristol, England.The company has existed for over forty-five years.It is difficult to transport very large, problematic goods.Each new order is a real challenge for employees.Viewers will see how giant machines, vehicles or spare parts are transported - from loading onto trucks of similar size to delivery to the destination.All goods must reach customers intact.Truck drivers are still fighting against time.
